title: [review] project-LICHEN-n8c6: TOFU key-change integration test removed
description: In python/tests/link/test_link_layer.py, the test_key_change_scenario section was deleted from TestTxQueueIntegration. This removal deleted the test that simulated a TOFU pin override (injecting a different key in _pinned_keys) and verified that a subsequent frame from the same peer triggers ReceiveError.KEY_CHANGE. This was the only integration-level test covering key-change detection, a security-critical behavior per spec section 8.5 (TOFU baseline). No replacement test was added.
